sloka: वसतो ऋश्यमूके मे पर्वते विपुलद्रुमे ।राघवो रणविक्रान्तो मित्रत्वं समुपागतः ।। ५.५८.१३५ ।।।।
transliteration: vasato ṛśyamūke me parvate vipuladrume ।rāghavo raṇavikrānto mitratvaṁ samupāgataḥ ।। 5.58.135 ।।।।

translations.english: 'While I was dwelling at the woodedmountain in Rshyamuka, a treaty of friendship was made with Rama, who is skilled in war.
